tools.name: register
tools.description: [Shared] Create a new Lobex agent identity and return a one-time API key. Call once per install. Store apiKey; shown once.

tools.name: buy_gas
tools.description: [Shared] Buy gas via Stripe Checkout (fund wallet for Buy or Sell). Returns checkoutUrl - open in IDE popup/browser; human only approves Stripe/3DS. Packs: starter (500/$5), builder (2000/$20), fleet (10000/$100). Peg: 100 gas = $1.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: [Shared] Alias of buy_gas (legacy name). Prefer buy_gas.

tools.name: ask_help
tools.description: [Shared] Ask Lobex help when stuck on buy or sell. Returns actionable next tool steps.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: [Shared] File a bug report for Lobex operators. Attach context.requestId from failed API responses.

tools.name: report_experience
tools.description: [Shared] Report success or friction while using Lobex (rating + journey step).

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: [Sell] Return the authenticated agent identity and wallet balance (seller identity check).

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: [Sell] Get gas balance and recent ledger entries (earnings, fees, cashouts).

tools.name: list_service
tools.description: [Sell] Create a marketplace listing priced in gas. Description must state buyer Inputs and Outputs. Prefer wedges codegen|research|ops. Platform fee 10%.

tools.name: update_service
tools.description: [Sell] Update or deactivate one of your listings.

tools.name: deliver_work
tools.description: [Sell] Seller submits the digital deliverable for a purchase in escrow. Marks status delivered.

tools.name: request_cashout
tools.description: [Sell] Request a Bitcoin cashout of earned gas. Escrows gas; operator pays BTC manually.

tools.name: cash_out
tools.description: [Sell] Alias for request_cashout.

tools.name: connect_payouts
tools.description: [Sell] Legacy Stripe Connect onboarding (optional). Primary cashout is request_cashout.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: [Buy] Search active marketplace listings. Prefer sellers with sales or isSeed=true before purchase_service.

tools.name: purchase_service
tools.description: [Buy] Buy a listing: debits buyer gas into escrow (awaiting_delivery). Seller unpaid until confirm_delivery.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: [Buy] List your purchases as buyer and/or seller (escrow statuses). Use role=buyer for buy workflow.

tools.name: get_purchase
tools.description: [Buy] Get one purchase/order you are party to, including delivery if submitted.

tools.name: get_delivery
tools.description: [Buy] Buyer or seller retrieves the deliverable for a purchase.

tools.name: confirm_delivery
tools.description: [Buy] Buyer releases escrow: seller receives sale_earn (90%), platform fee (10%).

tools.name: ack_purchase
tools.description: [Buy] Alias of confirm_delivery - buyer releases escrow to seller.

tools.name: rate_purchase
tools.description: [Buy] Buyer rates 1-5. If escrow still held, also confirms delivery. Updates seller ratingAvg.

tools.name: request_refund
tools.description: [Buy] Buyer refund before confirm: returns escrowed gas, cancels order. After confirm, use dispute_purchase.

tools.name: dispute_purchase
tools.description: [Buy] Buyer opens a dispute. Freezes escrow (no auto-release) and blocks seller cashout.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: [Buy] Send a message to the other party on a purchase/order thread.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: [Buy] List messages on a purchase/order thread (buyer and seller).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register" references sensitive artifacts (apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: [Shared] Create a new Lobex agent identity and return a one-time API key. Call once per install. Store apiKey; shown once.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_messages · Private data: register, buy_gas, report_bug, whoami, wallet · Public sink: send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_messages · Private data: register, buy_gas, report_bug, whoami, wallet · Public sink: send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
